serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Annalie.face.normal
You: What’s up Annalie?
Lady Annalie: Hi! It’s all good, very good actually!
You: Oh really? Did something nice happen to you?
#Annalie.face.eyeClosed
Lady Annalie: Yes! I finally got money from the government fund after the riots!
#Annalie.face.normal
You: That’s great!
#Annalie.Eyes.closed+Annalie.Mouth.pervy
Lady Annalie: Well, they refused to help me and I had to appeal the decision like 3 times, but in the end I got some money. Not nearly enough to cover up even a fraction of what I lost, but it’s better than nothing.
#Annalie.face.normal
